jobs.title: AI & Beyond Incubator (Ongoing Intake)
jobs.description: The  Bitmovin AI & Beyond Incubator is always open . We’re looking for ambitious students and early-career talent who want more than an internship on their CV. Whether you’re studying Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Marketing, Sales, Finance or something we haven't thought of yet; we care less about your job title and more about your curiosity, potential and what you can bring to the table. You might be in your third year. Working through your Master’s. About to graduate. If you think you’re ready to make an impact, we want to hear from you. This isn't work experience. Join the AI & Beyond Incubator and you'll become part of a real Bitmovin team, working on real problems from day one. You could be building technology, improving how we understand our customers, experimenting with new ways to go to market, solving a commercial challenge or pitching an idea of your own. You'll have people around you to learn from, but we’ll give you responsibility too.  AI is part of how we work. AI & Beyond started with a simple idea: give talented people the opportunity to experiment with AI and turn great ideas into something real . That hasn't changed. What has changed is how far we're taking it. Today, AI isn't limited to Engineering. It's changing how we build products, understand customers, analyse data, create, sell and operate. Whatever team you join, we want you experimenting with what's possible. Using AI, challenging it, and finding smarter ways to solve problems. You'll also have opportunities to collaborate with other Incubator talent on cross-functional AI projects and challenges. Bring your own ideas. Some of the best ideas don't start on a roadmap. If there’s something you think Bitmovin should build, change, automate or experiment with, pitch it . Incubator projects have the potential to make their way into Bitmovin products, become new internal capabilities, develop into independent ideas or be showcased to the industry at international trade shows. We don't just want people who can follow a brief. We want people who can spot an opportunity. More than an internship. The Incubator is also a community. You'll meet and learn from Bitmovin leaders, company founders, technologists and other ambitious students. Expect mentorship, talks, demos, customer interaction, shared challenges and plenty of opportunities to show what you've built. We run the incubator to find future Bitmovers. For exceptional people, your time in the Incubator could be the beginning of something much bigger at Bitmovin. Always open. Always looking.  The AI & Beyond Incubator runs throughout the year , with key intake points in Summer, Fall, and Spring. But exceptional people don't conveniently become available during a short recruitment window, so our door is always open. Depending on the opportunity, you could join alongside your studies, during your final year, as part of your Master's, or as you make the move from university into your career. Want to sign up? Search our careers page and upload your CV , latest transcript (Zeugnis), and a motivation video with your expectations for an internship at Bitmovin. We offer two-month summer internships as well as longer internships designed to work alongside your studies. We hire for potential, so your CV only tells us part of the story. Send us a short 2–3 minute video answering three questions: What do you want to learn, build or achieve during your time at Bitmovin? Tell us about a time you successfully hacked a non-computer system to your advantage. If you could tackle any problem involving video or AI, what would you choose and why? Guidelines for the video: Keep it concise (2-3 minutes). Be authentic and showcase your personality. Feel free to demonstrate your passion and creativity. This is your chance to stand out! Using the box below, enter a link to a Dropbox or Google Drive folder where you have stored your video (remember to allow view access for everyone) We look forward to hearing from you! jobs.title: Customer Technical Account Manager – OTT Cloud Streaming
jobs.description: Core skills: technical account management, OTT streaming architecture, cloud infrastructure, customer success, revenue expansion, stakeholder engagement, API integrations, media workflow optimization. Bitmovin is a global Series-C SaaS scale-up that provides award-winning video streaming technology to world-renowned brands and managed service providers. Our solution suite consists of Live and VOD Encoding, a Multi-Platform Player, and Analytics platform; enabling content owners to redefine the viewer experience through API-based workflow optimization, fast turnaround, and scalability. “We are constantly seeking out forward thinking individuals who want to shape the future of video... come and work with us!” — Stefan Lederer, CEO At Bitmovin we value cognitive diversity and the huge part this plays in not only creating a global culture second to none, but in how this underpins our ability to create truly representative, Emmy award-winning products. Diversity in all its forms is encouraged and celebrated; everyone has a role to play in helping us shape the future of video. Why us? Bitmovin is looking for a Customer Technical Account Manager to become the trusted technical advisor to leading Media & Entertainment OTT customers across the Middle East region, operating within Bitmovin's global GTM and partner framework to execute regional initiatives aligned to overall revenue objectives. This is an opportunity that offers: Customer Ownership: Act as the primary commercial and technical point of contact for strategic OTT customers in the Middle East. Technical Depth: Work hands-on with technical stakeholders advising on OTT workflows, solution options, and product integration. Commercial Impact: Drive product adoption resulting in upsell, cross-sell, expansion, and new customer opportunities. Regional Influence: Collaborate with global and local partners to maximize customer value and market growth, supported by our global solutions engineering and product teams.   What you’ll do: You will make an impact that matters by: Serving as the primary technical advisor and internal Bitmovin advocate for assigned Media & Entertainment OTT customers in the Middle East and key regional accounts. Engaging stakeholders from engineers to C-level executives — diving deep into APIs and integrations while clearly articulating business impact and ROI. Driving product adoption and successful onboarding of cloud streaming services. Identifying and executing upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities to grow existing customer revenue. Identifying and pursuing new logo opportunities within similar Media & Entertainment accounts. Leading or supporting integration projects, ensuring smooth implementation aligned with customer workflows. Troubleshooting streaming workflows, encoding pipelines, and delivery performance issues. Providing best-practice guidance on OTT architectures including live streaming, VOD, CDN integration, DRM, analytics, and API-based automation. Collaborating with Product, Support, and Global Partner teams to resolve issues and unlock additional customer value. Working with global and local partners to maximize customer success and regional growth opportunities. Monitoring customer health metrics and proactively mitigating risks to retention and revenue growth. Advocating customer needs internally, influencing product roadmap and feature prioritization.   What is it like to be a part of this team? You'll sit at the intersection of technology, business value, and revenue growth — working alongside global solutions engineering, product, and partner teams while owning your regional book of business directly. It's a role for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable moving between deep technical conversations and commercial ones, and motivated to combine technical engagement with regional influence.   What can you bring Must-Have Experience:   Experience in technical account management, customer success, solutions engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles. Experience within OTT, cloud streaming, or media delivery platforms (live, VOD, SaaS) in the Media & Entertainment sector. Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and streaming technologies. Strong understanding of streaming protocols (HLS, DASH, CMAF), DRM, CDN architectures, and video analytics. Experience with APIs, integrations, and supporting customer implementation projects. Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Global Partner teams to resolve technical challenges. Experience identifying and working with local partners to drive regional growth. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for executive audiences, and confidence engaging both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders. Fluency in English. A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is a plus but not required — equivalent hands-on experience is equally valued.   Nice-to-Have: Arabic language skills, for engaging regional stakeholders. Experience working with video processing, content delivery, and video streaming platforms. Familiarity with video playback QoE / QoS analytics such as Conviva, Mux, Youbora, or similar solutions. Scripting or automation skills (Python, Bash). Knowledge of Agile methodologies and SaaS customer success practices. Current AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, or Oracle Cloud "Professional" cloud certification (Solutions Architect, Cloud Architect, Cloud Developer, etc.), or "Associate" level certification with the ability to earn a "Professional" certification within 6 months. You don’t have experience with all the points above? Don’t worry, we will support you with learning, training, and coaching on the job. Diversity in all its forms is encouraged and celebrated at Bitmovin; everyone has a role to play in helping us shape the future of video.   Why will your impact matter?  At Bitmovin , we’re redefining how the world streams video. Our Emmy award-winning technology powers video for household names like Red Bull Media House, RTL, and Technicolor — and we’re just getting started. This is the first Forward Deployed Engineer at Bitmovin — a greenfield role where you'll define the playbook, not inherit one. You'll sit inside our Encoding engineering team, shipping production code in its sprints, while being the technical face of Bitmovin for our marquee US media and streaming customers. When Europe is offline, you're the one keeping US enterprise accounts moving: triaging encoding issues, driving incidents to resolution or a clean handover, and turning what you learn in the field into better product.   It's real engineering plus real customer ownership. The kind of hybrid profile that's hard to find and builds toward Staff Engineer, Solutions Architecture leadership, or founding-engineer-style roles.   What you’ll do: Contribute production code (Java/Kotlin, C++ encoding stack) as an embedded member of the Encoding team's sprints Own our US enterprise accounts technically: cover the timezone gap, triage and troubleshoot encoding issues during EU off-hours, and drive incidents to resolution or a safe handover Travel to customer sites to support integrations, run workshops, and handle escalations in person Feed field learnings back into sprint planning and the product roadmap Make sound escalate-vs-resolve calls autonomously, and keep the EU team looped in through clear async communication What success looks like (6–12 months):   You've become the trusted US technical point of contact for our marquee media and streaming accounts. Those customers escalate to you by name and response times during EU off-hours have visibly improved. You're shipping production code in the Encoding team's sprints, not just triaging. You've closed real issues in the core encoding stack (Java/Kotlin, C++), not just filed them. You've defined the Forward Deployed playbook from scratch: how issues get triaged, when to resolve vs. escalate, how handovers to the EU team happen cleanly. It's written down and repeatable, not living in your head. You've run at least one on-site customer integration or workshop end to end, and the customer came away more self-sufficient. Field learnings from your accounts have shaped sprint planning or the roadmap at least once, with a concrete example the team can point to. Churn risk on your accounts is down and measurably so, with faster resolution and fewer issues aging overnight. The EU team trusts you to own US hours solo. Your async updates are clear enough that Europe picks up where you left off without friction. You've built a clear picture of how customers actually use our product day to day, and turned it into documentation the product and engineering teams actually rely on.   What can you bring Must-Have Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience at a senior level, strong in Java or C++, able to contribute production code in the encoding team's sprints 2+ years in a customer-facing technical role (solutions architecture, professional services, forward deployed, or named-account support) Cloud experience (AWS and/or GCP), Docker, and hands-on experience running and debugging scalable distributed services Strong troubleshooting on live customer systems: log analysis, error diagnosis, network traces, reproducing issues from limited information Open to AI-assisted development workflows and comfortable using AI tools like Claude Code Excellent written and verbal English, with a track record of communicating credibly with enterprise engineering teams High autonomy: comfortable owning issues end-to-end during US hours while the EU team is offline, with sound judgment on when to escalate vs. resolve Experience being responsible for maintaining production systems, preferably experienced with on-call, incident management, or 24/7 operations Based on the US East Coast or in Denver, and willing to travel to customer sites regularly You must already have the right to work in the United States.   Nice-to-Have: Video streaming domain knowledge: codecs (H.264/HEVC, ideally AV1), container formats, HLS/DASH, OTT encoding workflows Prior forward-deployed, solutions architect, or professional services experience at a SaaS or media-tech vendor Experience with Bitmovin or competing encoding platforms (AWS MediaConvert/Elemental, Harmonic, MediaKind) You don’t have experience with all the points above? Don’t worry, we will support you with learning, training, and coaching on the job.   Why do this at Bitmovin There is a lot on offer here: View the benefits on our Careers Page Get to know our outstanding culture showcased on LinkedIn Check the employee reviews on Glassdoor Apply for the role, and let’s get talking!

We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and foster an inclusive, flexible work environment where every team member can thrive. We move fast, try new things, and care deeply about the impact our work creates.   The Role We’re looking for a hands-on, curious, and commercially minded Marketing Executive to join our team. This is a broad execution role, you’ll work closely with and take direction from the VP of Marketing on strategy, while owning the day-to-day delivery of campaigns across PR, content, social, and demand generation. You’re not someone who ticks tasks off a list and moves on. You’re someone who cares about outcomes, who stays curious about whether something actually worked, and who actively pushes to make it better. You embrace AI tools not as a novelty, but as a genuine part of how you work and think, and engage with the market. This role is a real opportunity to grow . We want someone who’ll build their career here, developing their craft, expanding their impact, and helping shape how Bitmovin shows up in the market.   What You’ll Do Content & Demand Generation       Create compelling content across the funnel: from awareness-driving stories to conversion-focused assets for paid social and email nurture.       Support bespoke prospect/customer campaign content in close collaboration with the wider marketing and sales teams.       Develop written and video customer case studies that bring our clients’ success stories to life. Campaign Execution & Project Management       Own the end-to-end delivery of marketing campaigns: proactively coordinating contributors from across the business, leading campaign meetings, managing timelines, and keeping everyone accountable for their inputs on time and sequence.        Work closely with the VP of Marketing to bring campaign strategies to life, translating direction into well-executed, on-brand activity.       Track campaign performance, report on outcomes, and proactively suggest improvements based on what the data tells you. PR & Communications       Lead our day-to-day PR execution: drafting press releases, byline articles, and media pitches, and building relationships with key industry journalists and publications.       Support executive communications including newsletters, thought leadership content, and spokesperson materials.       Manage our awards programme — identifying opportunities, writing submissions, and hitting deadlines. Content & Demand Generation       Create compelling content across the funnel: from awareness-driving stories to conversion-focused assets for paid social and email nurture.       Support bespoke prospect/customer campaign content in close collaboration with the wider marketing and sales teams.       Develop written and video customer case studies that bring our clients’ success stories to life. Social Media & Brand       Manage Bitmovin’s organic, paid LinkedIn presence as well as employee social advocacy program: growing reach, driving engagement, and contributing to lead generation.       Ensure brand messaging stays consistent and impactful across all channels, bringing fresh and engaging ways to ensure content positioning is always evolving.  AI & Innovation       Actively use AI tools in your day-to-day work: for research, content creation, campaign optimisation, workflow implementation and beyond.       Bring fresh ideas on how AI can improve how we work, and be willing to experiment, test, and share what you learn.       Help the team stay ahead of emerging trends in marketing technology and digital communication.   What You’ll Bring       A few years of experience in a marketing, content, or communications role - ideally in a B2B tech or SaaS environment.       Genuine excitement about AI and emerging tools, and a track record of finding practical ways to use them in your work.       Strong writing skills - you can craft a compelling press release, a social post, and a nurture email, and you know they’re different things.       A project management mindset - you can hold a campaign together, coordinate multiple contributors, and keep things moving without being chased.       Commercial awareness - you understand that marketing exists to drive results, and you care about whether your work actually converts.       A collaborative, energetic approach - you’re comfortable working across teams and know how to bring people along with you.       Curiosity and adaptability - you’re not fazed by change, you lean into the unfamiliar, and you’re always looking for a better way to do things. Don’t worry if you don’t tick every box. If you’re driven, eager to learn, and excited by where this role could take you, we want to hear from you.   How to Apply Upload your CV and a short motivation video (2–3 minutes). We’d love to get a sense of who you are and how you think, this is your chance to stand out. In your video, please cover the following: Tell us about a campaign or piece of work you’re proud of - what was your role, what did you actually do, and what impact did it have? Be specific about outcomes. Walk us through how you currently use AI in your work - what tools do you use, what problems have they helped you solve, and where do you see the most untapped potential? We’re not looking for a polished answer here, we want to understand your genuine relationship with these tools and your appetite to push further. Video guidelines:       Keep it to 2–3 minutes.       Be yourself! Authenticity matters more than polish.       Feel free to demonstrate creativity in how you present yourself.       Upload to Google Drive or Dropbox and paste a view-accessible link in the application form. Bitmovin does not accept unsolicited referrals or resumes from any source other than directly from candidates.
